name: EmployeeInformationForm

description: Collect essential personal and employment information from new employees to initiate the onboarding process.

validation.message: Please enter a valid first name
Please enter a valid last name
Please enter a valid email address
Please enter a valid phone number
Please enter a valid job title
Please select a valid start date

name: DirectDepositForm

description: Securely provide your banking information for payroll direct deposit. Your information is encrypted and protected.

validation.message: Bank name must be between 2 and 100 characters

Account number must be between 4 and 17 digits
Allocation must be between 1 and 100 percent

fields.name: authorizationConsent
fields.label: I authorize my employer to deposit my pay into the account specified above and to make adjustments for any overpayments

validation.message: You must authorize direct deposit to proceed

name: EmergencyContactForm

description: Provide emergency contact details for your employee record. Please list at least one primary contact who can be reached in case of an emergency.

validation.message: Please enter a valid phone number
Please enter a valid phone number
Please enter a valid email address

fields.name: address
fields.label: Full Address
fields.placeholder: Enter street address, city, state, and ZIP code

validation.message: Please select your citizenship or immigration status
Enter valid USCIS or Alien Registration Number
Please select the document type you will provide

fields.name: documentUpload
fields.label: Upload Identity Document(s)

Maintain equipment in good working condition

Return all equipment upon termination or request
